notes.title: 👻 BOO! Play our FREE DEMO now! ✨
notes.content: [p]We're so grateful to be included in the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45022621/sale/TheHungryGhostFestival2025"]Hungry Ghost Festival[/url] this year! They have graciously decided to platform the Usual June demo from now until September 13th! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781304/8f0949e1f539407eed05dbe08bae829e9a4c43f0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]However, this opportunity goes beyond Steam. For those that don't know, the Hungry Ghost Festival is a real life festival celebrated each year by Buddhist and Taoist people in order to honor the memories of the dead. Usually people will make offerings of food or other amenities to ghosts so that they will be able to use them in the afterlife. Some people even put on shows and leave the front row seats open for visitors that have passed on! [/p][p][/p][p]Please enjoy the demo and consider pulling up an empty chair next to you while you play! You never know who might want to watch too. [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/finji"]Follow the Finji publisher page! [/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Usual June DEV UPDATE
notes.content: [p]We've got more ghosts, more mysteries, and horrifying new boss monsters getting ready to infest this unsuspecting college town. We're staying very busy creating new environments, using our new animation tools to beef up our NPCs, and diving deep into the weird realities and urban legends of midwestern cities. We all know truth is stranger than fiction, but it's extra strange in the flyover states. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781304/88132302366d6c76ed8d66ad4feef4f3e7a76394.gif"][/img][/p][p]Above you can see our Animator Mike showing off Sunny's expressions! With this rig and our new animation tools, she can respond to every situation her adventure might throw at her. What do you think she's saying in that gif? [/p][p][/p][p]We sent this update in our newsletter last week! [url="https://finji.co/signup.html"]Sign up for it today[/url] if you're interested in getting monthly (most of the time) news on this and our other award-winning games! [/p]

notes.title: Free Usual June Demo - Available Now! 👻
notes.content: [p]Ah SHOOT!! Did we miss the Steam Next Fest? Well, if you're looking for something to fill the void from all those absolutely incredible free demos, you can play this one! [/p][p][/p][p]Hop through the portal into Fen Harbor, where June, her friend Sunny (alive), and her new friend(?) Teddy (dead) are exploring an abandoned building. Who used to occupy this mysterious space? And why is there a portal into a dimension filled with monsters? And WHY does Teddy know where to go in there? AND WHAT'S ON HIS HEAD?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781304/6ac02998a7a645f71478a65dd5d599e640e2eab0.png"][/img][/p][p]Since this demo came out last summer, we've been working hard on more friends, more locations in June and Sunny's college town, and more glowy enemies! We can't wait to introduce you to everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has wishlisted the game so far! Don't forget to follow [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/finji"]Finji's publisher page[/url]. Not only do we have lots of other beautiful games for you to play, but we've got some pretty cool stuff coming up that you might want to hear about! [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Play the Usual June Demo for Free Until May 5th!
notes.content:
We couldn't be more excited that the folks at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/LudoNarraCon?tab=2]LudoNarraCon[/url] added Usual June to their brilliant line up of Official Selection games! That means our demo has returned from the dead, only until May 5th! Tell your friends to give it a try, too!

Don't forget to wishlist them while you're at it! It's one of the most helpful things you can do for indie developers.

notes.title: Watch The Usual June Art Director Talk Art!
notes.content:
Finji Community Manager Aster Wright gathered some of our artistic powerhouses to talk about how they make art, why they make art, and how it fits into their games.

Witness the ever-so-charming Richard Hogg ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/839870/Wilmots_Warehouse/]Wilmot’s Warehouse[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2060590/Wilmot_Works_It_Out/]Wilmot Works It Out[/url]), the intelligence of Amelia Herman ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2702430/Usual_June/]Usual June[/url]), and the subtle charisma of Andrew Shouldice ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/553420/TUNIC/]TUNIC[/url]) in this stream.

[previewyoutube=5V8o5kXmvZ8;full][/previewyoutube]

If you’re interested in seeing more dev chats, Aster Wright gets devs together on a fairly regular basis over on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/finjico]Twitch[/url]! Follow for notifications when we go live.

notes.title: ✨ Check Out the Usual June Demo! ✨
notes.content:
Thanks to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/IABRecap] Indie Arena Booth's Recap event[/url], the Usual June demo is available one more time!

We premiered this pre-alpha demo at IAB during Gamescom this year, and we had such a lovely time. Talking to people face-to-face about what more we have coming for the game was so fun. It's nice to relive those memories with this recap event. 🥹 

[previewyoutube=MGpjqqGxllI;full][/previewyoutube]

So try it out! Talk to some ghosts, good luck fighting those crabs, and wishlist the game if you want to stay up-to-date on development!

notes.title: Usual June 👻 Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
This Halloween season, you can catch us talking to ghosts in the Usual June demo! Specifically, one little weird, but sweet, ghost boy named Teddy! 

[h2]You can play the Usual June demo now through October 21st![/h2]

Go fight some glowy crab things, investigate the dark secrets of Fen Harbor, and get to know June, Sunny, and Teddy! Don't forget to wishlist the game for updates throughout its development and come hang out with us in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/finji]Finji discord[/url]! 

[h2]💀 Brand New Usual June Pins! 💀[/h2]

Make no bones about it, you're going to look very fun with this pin on a jacket! We premiered our brand new [url=https://www.compressmerch.com/collections/finji/products/usual-june-pinny-arcade-enamel-pin]Usual June skull pins[/url] at PAX West last month, but you can grab one online right now at [url=https://www.compressmerch.com/collections/finji]shop.finji.co[/url]! 
While you're over there, you can also grab the stylish official [url=https://www.compressmerch.com/collections/finji/products/uj-tee]Usual June t-shirt[/url]! Both items glow-in-the-dark, so your friends won't lose you in any dark and dusty observatories.

notes.title: Play the Usual June Demo today!
notes.content:
The Usual June demo is now playable on Steam through September 2nd!

This one goes out to everyone who can't be at PAX West or Gamescom, to the people who won't have time to sit down at our booth and try out the game, and to the people who just want to try whaling on some multi-dimensional creatures again and again! 

So grab your controller, get comfy, and go meet a couple of June's friends! And don't forget to wishlist the game so you can keep track of our updates and announcements. 

We're so excited to be getting to see people at our live events, but if you can be there, make sure to check in with us on [url=https://discord.gg/finji]Discord[/url]. We'd love to hear from you!

notes.content:
